name: FiveAPI
tagline: Video REST API: text, image, or reference to MP4, plus extend. Prepaid credits; keys after review.
description: FiveAPI is a video generation REST API for developers. One API key can create async tasks for text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, and video extend, then return an MP4 by signed webhook or polling. Billing is prepaid credit packs with no subscription and no minimum spend; new production accounts are reviewed before they can create keys. Result URLs are kept for 7 days and should be downloaded to your own storage.
